additional_protocol_coverage_assessment.inspected_wrapper_behavior: read_error requires L2 response handshake; fatal response overrides normal progression to status8/DONE; DONE and FLUSH reset payload and Matrix. Normal error consumes and drains its read first. External reset requires accompanying fabric reset to discard unconsumed responses.
additional_protocol_coverage_assessment.original_trace_verifier_reuse_limitation: Historical verifier assumes first matching A read errors and all accepted Matrix inputs produce outputs. A late abort legitimately drops in-flight Matrix work, so do not claim the unmodified original full-suite verifier applies.
additional_protocol_coverage_assessment.proposed_targeted_test: Transient selected-head chain bench, lookahead enabled, actual SharedL2 and Matrix and case1 oracle, zero artificial L2 response delay. Error only on accepted next_a_request with k_q>=1 while MQ blocked. Assert held erroneous reply before Matrix fire, status8/flush/quiet after response handshake, no tile write, exact accepted Matrix step count including aborted work; separately reset pending early response with fabric reset. Complete original selected-K recovery after each.

checked_properties: Replay admission/response/ACK budgets use command-local ordinal, channel and domain hash, not elapsed cycles or global LFSR.
Admission countdown begins on first request valid and persists until handshake; replay DMA response delay starts after data transfer.
Real SharedL2 ready/response handshakes remain in the datapath and runtime assertions retain exactly one port0 read owner.
Default random delay branches and force-block expressions retain legacy semantics; lookahead parameters remain default-off.
Metrics sample accepted-start through done inclusively; paired useful work uses fixed512 lanes and all command cycles.
Pending-cycle occupancy and request-response latency include the response edge and handle same-cycle write ACK with zero latency.
Complete trace is iterated through EOF with independent input/source/all512-output checking; failure aborts and cleans up the stream processes.
Source hashes, generated hardware manifest, and source-bound fixture receipts/files are checked before and after execution.
